cards.back:
The subject where you learn about numbers and shapes.
Bahasa Indonesia: matematika
Example: We learn fractions in maths today.
cards.say: maths. The subject where you learn about numbers and shapes. We learn fractions in maths today.

cards.back:
The subject where you learn how the world works.
Bahasa Indonesia: IPA, sains
Example: In science, we grew beans in a cup.
cards.say: science. The subject where you learn how the world works. In science, we grew beans in a cup.

cards.back:
The subject about things that happened long ago.
Bahasa Indonesia: sejarah
Example: History taught me about ancient kings.
cards.say: history. The subject about things that happened long ago. History taught me about ancient kings.

cards.back:
The subject about countries, maps and land.
Bahasa Indonesia: geografi
Example: In geography, we found Indonesia on a map.
cards.say: geography. The subject about countries, maps and land. In geography, we found Indonesia on a map.

cards.back:
The subject where you draw and paint.
Bahasa Indonesia: seni rupa
Example: We painted flowers in art class.
cards.say: art. The subject where you draw and paint. We painted flowers in art class.

cards.back:
The subject where you sing and play instruments.
Bahasa Indonesia: musik
Example: We sing songs in music lessons.
cards.say: music. The subject where you sing and play instruments. We sing songs in music lessons.

cards.back:
The subject where you do exercise and play sports.
Bahasa Indonesia: pendidikan jasmani
Example: We play netball in PE on Mondays.
cards.say: P E. The subject where you do exercise and play sports. We play netball in PE on Mondays.

cards.back:
The subject where you learn about computers.
Bahasa Indonesia: informatika, komputer
Example: In computing, we made a simple game.
cards.say: computing. The subject where you learn about computers. In computing, we made a simple game.

cards.back:
A list that shows when each lesson is.
Bahasa Indonesia: jadwal pelajaran
Example: Check the timetable to see our next lesson.
cards.say: timetable. A list that shows when each lesson is. Check the timetable to see our next lesson.

cards.back:
A time when a teacher teaches a class.
Bahasa Indonesia: pelajaran
Example: The first lesson starts at eight o'clock.
cards.say: lesson. A time when a teacher teaches a class. The first lesson starts at eight o'clock.

cards.back:
School work that you do at home.
Bahasa Indonesia: pekerjaan rumah (PR)
Example: I finish my homework before dinner.
cards.say: homework. School work that you do at home. I finish my homework before dinner.

cards.back:
A short rest between lessons.
Bahasa Indonesia: istirahat
Example: We play outside with our friends at break.
cards.say: break. A short rest between lessons. We play outside with our friends at break.

cards.back:
An outdoor area at school where children play.
Bahasa Indonesia: lapangan bermain
Example: We run around on the playground.
cards.say: playground. An outdoor area at school where children play. We run around on the playground.

cards.back:
A room where a class has lessons.
Bahasa Indonesia: ruang kelas
Example: Our classroom has a big window.
cards.say: classroom. A room where a class has lessons. Our classroom has a big window.

cards.back:
A flat tool for drawing straight lines.
Bahasa Indonesia: penggaris
Example: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
cards.say: ruler. A flat tool for drawing straight lines. Use a ruler to draw a straight line.

cards.back:
A small thing that takes away pencil marks, also called an eraser.
Bahasa Indonesia: penghapus
Example: I used a rubber to fix my mistake.
cards.say: rubber. A small thing that takes away pencil marks, also called an eraser. I used a rubber to fix my mistake.

cards.back:
A small bag for pens and pencils.
Bahasa Indonesia: kotak pensil
Example: My pencil case has a red pen inside.
cards.say: pencil case. A small bag for pens and pencils. My pencil case has a red pen inside.

cards.back:
A sticky liquid that joins things together.
Bahasa Indonesia: lem
Example: We used glue to stick the paper down.
cards.say: glue. A sticky liquid that joins things together. We used glue to stick the paper down.

cards.back:
A tool with two blades for cutting paper.
Bahasa Indonesia: gunting
Example: Be careful when you use the scissors.
cards.say: scissors. A tool with two blades for cutting paper. Be careful when you use the scissors.

cards.back:
A book that tells you the meanings of words.
Bahasa Indonesia: kamus
Example: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
cards.say: dictionary. A book that tells you the meanings of words. I looked up the word in a dictionary.

cards.back:
A set of questions to show what you know.
Bahasa Indonesia: ulangan, tes
Example: We have a spelling test on Friday.
cards.say: test. A set of questions to show what you know. We have a spelling test on Friday.

cards.back:
An area of study at school.
Bahasa Indonesia: mata pelajaran
Example: Science is my favourite subject at school.
cards.say: subject. An area of study at school. Science is my favourite subject at school.
